encoding-memories-serial.alt: A line graph of the percent of people who recalled each word, by its position in a 15-word list heard once and recalled right away in any order (invented data for practice). Recall starts high for the first words (72% for word 1), falls to about 30% for the middle words (29% at its lowest), then rises for the last words (88% for word 15). The high start is labeled the primacy effect and the high end the recency effect.
